title: Untitled Discourses on Ten to Forty Qualities (3rd)
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 10 Numbered Discourses 10.233–236
  • 22. Sāmaññavagga 22. Similarity

~ Untitled Discourses on Ten to Forty Qualities (3rd)

“Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo …pe… “A fool is known by ten qualities … paṇḍito veditabbo …pe… astute person … vīsatiyā, bhikkhave …pe… twenty … tiṁsāya, bhikkhave …pe… thirty … cattārīsāya, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo …pe… forty …” paṇḍito veditabbo …pe… imehi kho, bhikkhave, cattārīsāya dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo”ti.

Sāmaññavaggo dutiyo.
